The rooms were fine. If you love decor, you will probably not like the rooms as some of them are so dull and dreary.

The bathroom and shower are fine also. And most importantly, they're clean.

The bed was absolutely horrible. It's so squeaky, which makes a lot of noise that can wake you up.

The location is fine too. A bit noisy, but its amid the city center and it's beside a police station. As a result, it's fairly safe. You'll also find all what you need near you.

The breakfast is basic. Croissants were just like bread though lol. Oh well, at least the coffee was good.

Receptionists were nice too.

Now, with that being said, for 3800 DA a night for a single room, it's a bit expensive for the value given. If you can afford to pay between 4600 - 4900 DA, you're better off choosing other hotels. Note that I visited in October which is apparently a more expensive season in Biskra (probably because it's the dates harvest season), so prices will change probably. This hotel charged 3000 DA/night before October and I think that's a more acceptable price.

If you're in a tight budget, and you're okay with the remarks I shared, I recommend this hotel.
